slug.description: Unique lowercase identifier. Must match the filename: templates/<slug>.json

logo_url.description: HTTPS image URL, or empty for the default icon

image.description: Docker image WITHOUT tag, e.g. 'n8nio/n8n' or 'postgres'

default_tag.description: Image tag. Prefer a pinned version over 'latest' where the project tags releases.

host.description: Suggested host port. Panelica remaps automatically on conflict.

host_ip.description: Bind address. Data services (databases, caches) MUST use 127.0.0.1; the panel asks the user before exposing anything publicly.

default.description: Placeholders allowed: {{slug}}, {{server_ip}}, {{domain}}. Leave secrets empty — Panelica auto-generates them.

secret.description: true = treated as a credential: hidden in UI, auto-generated when default is empty

source.description: Named volume only, prefixed with {{slug}} (e.g. '{{slug}}_data'). Host paths are not allowed.

linked_services.description: Sidecar containers for multi-container apps (databases, caches, workers). Each runs on the same private network as the main container.

name_suffix.description: Container is named <slug>-<name_suffix> and is reachable under that hostname from the other containers

from_env.description: Copy the resolved value of this main-container env var (use for shared secrets)

command.description: JSON array string or empty, e.g. '["sh", "-c", "..."]'
Container command as an argv array

post_deploy_commands.description: Commands executed INSIDE the main container after it starts (e.g. a one-time init). Runs with the container's own user.

cap_add.description: Only the whitelisted capabilities are accepted. Anything else (and 'privileged') is rejected.

post_install_notes.description: Shown to the user after deployment: first-boot duration, where to create the admin account, etc.

credential_patterns.description: Access card shown after deploy. Placeholders: {{server_ip}}, {{env:VAR_NAME}} (resolves a generated secret)

contributed_by.description: Your GitHub username — shown as the template credit

tier.description: Set by maintainers in review. 'community' templates carry a Community badge and the contributor credit in the panel; 'official' is reserved for templates Panelica maintains.
